title: The Harbor of Junebug Creek
author: Wendell Quintana
blurb: Jonah Ravensworth, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
